snippet.title: Fangs to Fields - Demo Teaser (Wishlist Now on Steam!)
snippet.description:
Try the Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3919620/Fangs_to_Fields
Wishlist on Steam!

A relaxing idle-farming game you can play on the edge of your desktop screen. Grow and harvest dozens of different crops while working, browsing or resting.
